notes.title: Aug 10 update
notes.notes: [p]This update brings a number of important bugfixes and requested usability features[/p][p][/p][p]- Option to disable edge panning[/p][p]- Panning speed options[/p][p]- Can use left mouse button to pan the world[/p][p]- Fixed the issue with activating spells with spacebar when not intended[/p][p]- Updated Chinese translation[/p][p]- Added WIP Japanese translation[/p][p]- Added WIP Swedish translation[/p][p]- Added WIP Ukrainian translation[/p][p]- Added WIP Russian translation[/p][p]- Fixed annoying issue with workers returning to original when you try to drag them[/p][p]- Fixed issue with max fps not working[/p][p]- Default max fps is 120[/p][p]- Fixed issue with default full screen mode and resolution not setting after restart[/p]

notes.title: Update - Aug 2
notes.notes: [p]This small update brings some fixes and a small but very important feature. Changelog:[/p][p][/p][p]- Creature "Story" tab was improved with more descriptions. Some monsters now have extensive descriptions.[/p][p]- Spell targeting type and range is now shown in spell tooltip[/p][p]- Fixed link to creatures and resources in tooltips displaying nothing instead of the item[/p][p]- Improved tutorial flow (fixed some parallel tutorial tracks starting at the same time)[/p][p]- Buffed "Heroism" belief (now it accounts non-producing workers in the group, gives much stronger bonus, but only to them)[/p][p]- Updated Chinese translation (all creature names are translated now)[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update (July 30)
notes.notes: [p]This small update addresses some issues and even adds some new content (4 spells)[/p][p][/p][p]- Some event choice texts were bigger than their buttons[/p][p]- Fixed tooltip issues[/p][p]- Fir's On Consume now gives exp instead of something useless[/p][p]- Crystals can now be mined 5 times instead of 2[/p][p]- All metals can be mined for a bit more[/p][p]- All creature sources can be mined less times[/p][p]- Fixed issues with adding exp on productions[/p][p]- All production and exploration now gives a little bit of exp as intended[/p][p]- Resources list (top left button) has received some love and you can use it now[/p][p]- Ending turn closes extra windows[/p][p]- Rotated that sword in the main menu...[/p][p]- New resources notification now doesn't stretch offscreen[/p][p]- New resources notification now hides resources you've already seen[/p][p]- New workers notification now doesn't stretch offscreen[/p][p]- New production-related spells: Whip, Sloth, Endure, Supervise[/p][p]- Commander training now gives some of these spells instead of WIP ones[/p][p]- Clearer short descriptions for Influence and other understandings like it[/p][p]- Fixed remaining issues with tutorials appearing even when they are disabled[/p]

notes.title: Version 250727 - Fixes
notes.notes: [p]New update is live! It mostly addresses bugs, but there are some UX improvements:[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed issues with settings/unlockables don't save if the game crashed[/p][p]- Fixed issue where tutorials were displayed again or when tutorials were disabled[/p][p]- Fixed issue where borders weren't updated if a production change affects them (e.g. with repositioned creatures)[/p][p]- Fixed issue with wrong engineering production counts being limited[/p][p]- If you can't place movement order due to no orders, creatures will still be repositioned next to right click[/p][p]- Fixed disappearing tooltips in ability list[/p][p]- Reward hint is more visible[/p][p]- More fixes with tutorials blocking gameplay[/p][p]- Esc hides shown tutorial now[/p][p]- Buildings (excluding fortifications) production count is now limited[/p][p]- Fixed the issue when consumables were applying effects permanently[/p][p]- UX improvements in settings and tooltips[/p][p]- Can select language in main menu[/p][p]- Version number in main menu[/p][p]- Fixed crash with some of the training productions (but couldn't reproduce the issue with workers not being assigned yet)[/p]

notes.title: July Content Update & Public Demo!
notes.notes: [p]This is the most important update on Colossal Citadels so far! The demo is out, and you are able to try the game yourself! It is still might be in a rough state, but I think it’s good enough for now. Don’t hesitate to leave any (constructive and non-constructive) feedback in our [url="https://discord.gg/DuPtne2"]Discord[/url]. Check out the full post for lots of more notes.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's get to gameplay updates![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Archive: Discoverable Resources[/b][/h2][p]This is a golden gem of a feature that I came up with a couple of months ago. It both simplifies the game for new players and adds an unique exploration elements.[/p][p]There are many subtypes of the same resource type: e.g. Limestone, Granite, Marble are all Stones - they will give slightly different stats to items and buildings you produce from it. This is what resource effects look like:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867729/f159e4a477f196da4f687ec5f7076407ef0e8abc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But to a new player, these differences are almost neglegible! Having this choice gives them too many information plus an option paralysis. These effects are ignored and devaluated in player’s eyes as he tries to grasp more general concepts.[/p][p]The solution is to make these effects discoverable - you will know what it does only when it affects you:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867729/e8d87ab0004518da29e1e66451c0d807ee64b7b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In multiplayer, the information will be shared. This ties greatly with Procedural Resources - ores that are new for every playthrough will be always hidden at first.[/p][h2][b]Archive: The List[/b][/h2][p]Now there is also a database of all unlocked resource types and their effects. You will see a completion rate that counts all unlocked resources and effects![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867729/f6e124bd2f75365563ae89c0fcef51a7810c7f64.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It is also planned to list all Understandings and other types of content here.[/p][h2][b]Tech Recipes[/b][/h2][p]They received some overhaul! As you remember, Weapon Recipes and Building Recipes are Understandings that let you produce new weapon or building types. Getting these is always available to the player, but there is a third, more rare recipe type: Tech Recipes. These can contain a mastery on how to produce some exquisite paper type, air ships, or even mechanical golems![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867729/82ce7d5754cd1cf9467be98472c1a5bff8ca413d.png"][/img][/p][p]In this update, I made tech recipes playable. You can even get one in the early game.[/p][h2][b]Booze[/b][/h2][p]This is a preparation for some future fundamental update regarding morale/spirit of your workers. Alcohol is a consumable that restores Spirit every turn for a little bit. On harder difficulties it will be very helpful, but it will come with it’s own drawbacks.[/p][p]You will be able to produce some kinds of alcohol from different sources (e.g. Rum from cane, or Ale from wheat) and they will give you slightly different effects.[/p][p]This makes use of the new consumable system. There might be other consumables for your worker later.[/p][p]To support that, some other resource types were added, such as pottery, glass vessels, etc.[/p][h2][b]Colossuses and Fortifications[/b][/h2][p]These are colossal assault creatures/automatons that you build from a really big pile of stone. They are literally walking citadels. Now you can produce them, if you get the correct tech.[/p][p]Speaking of regular fortifications, now they are much more useful and they provide armor to nearby creatures. Moreover, if you surround your creatures with walls, they will get even more armor![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41867729/e87fddc57bbfc87f8a4e67409ca1955597b9b6a0.png"][/img][/p][p]The armor is not stacked from multiple fortifications, but it’s really useful for defensive gameplay! You should cover your city area with defense bonuses for maximum efficiency.[/p][h2][b]Further Movements[/b][/h2][p]The demo will now participate in some game festivals! Now I should really work on promotion, but you can contribute too: please tell your friends about the game if you like it![/p][h2][b]Full changelog[/b][/h2][list][*][p]lots of new tutorial messages and tutorial improvements[/p][/*][*][p]fortifications overhaul[/p][list][*][p]nearby fortifications defense bonus[/p][/*][*][p]more defense bonus for towers[/p][/*][*][p]more defense bonus for workers surrounded by walls[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]improved a lot of descriptions and updated some icons[/p][/*][*][p]archive[/p][list][*][p]unlockable resources[/p][/*][*][p]unlockable effects[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]movement border visualization[/p][/*][*][p]new resources: mirror metal, medicine, cane, cement[/p][/*][*][p]Granite Colossus, Marble Colossus, and Limestone Colossus tech recipes (very expensive and powerful)[/p][/*][*][p]tutorial reset in new game menu[/p][/*][*][p]updates to many understandings[/p][/*][*][p]tech recipes improvements[/p][list][*][p]tech recipes are given to the player in the starting pool (only 1)[/p][/*][*][p]tech recipes give choice of 3 recipes instead of two[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]consumables system - now there are resources that can be consumed every turn that are not food[/p][list][*][p]alcohol: ale, wine, rum, absinthe[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]glass vessels and pottery[/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]rebalanced HOARD targets and enemy strength[/p][/*][*][p]houses now give some spirit and health regeneration[/p][/*][*][p]skip subturns via double clicking while subturns are playing[/p][/*][*][p]made The Distortionist’s model cooler[/p][/*][*][p]autosaving is now simpler and it remembers both the beginning and the end of the turns[/p][/*][*][p]bug and feedback reporting[/p][/*][*][p]simplified menus and settings[/p][/*][*][p]localization and naming fixes[/p][list][*][p]finished chinese localizations[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]worked on limiting the demo content[/p][/*][*][p]fixed A LOT of bugs[/p][list][*][p]fixed issue wrongly blocking all buttons[/p][/*][*][p]defeating the boss also ends the demo now with a victory message[/p][/*][*][p]fixed issues with unlocking new difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]fixed crashes with Flash and Blinding Light spells[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]new bugs[/p][/*][/list]
